a: Umeshavve lehu zuzi; may amrat – shet mea istere vezuza, shet mea zuze vechad zuza? yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.

Amar abbaye: hay man devae lemachve chatimut yedeh beve dina, la lachve besof megilleta; dilma mashkach la acher vechatev demassek beh zuzi, utenan: hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyayv lo – gove minnechasim bene chorin.

Hahu bazbayna daata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: naychze li mar chatimut yedeh, dechi atu rabbanan machvu li, meabbarna lehu bela michsa. achvi leh beresh megilleta. hava ka naged beh, amar leh: kevar kadmucha rabbanan.
Amar abbaye: mittelat vead asar – la lichtov besof shita, dilma mezayyef vechatev. vei itremi leh, nayhdereh ledibbureh teren telata zimne, i efshar dela mitreme leh beemtza shita.
Hahu dahava ketiv beh: "tilta befardesa". azal machkeh legaggeh devet vechareh, veshavveye "ufardesa", ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: may tama reviach leh alma lehay vav? kafteh veodi.

Hahu dahava ketiv beh: "menat reuven veshimon ache". hava lehu acha dishmeh "achay", azal ketav beh vav, veshavveye "veachay". ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: may tama dechik leh alma lehay vav kulle hay? kafteh veodi.

Hahu shetara dahava chatim aleh rava verav acha bar adda. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: den chatimut yeda didi hi, mihu kammeh derav acha bar adda la chatimi li meolam! kafteh veodi. amar leh: bishlama didi – zayyeft, ella derav acha bar adda, deratet yedeh – hechi avadt? amar: annachi yeday ammitzra. veamri la: kam azzarnuka uchetav.
Mishna kotvin get laish – af al pi sheen ishto immo, vehashshovar laishsha – af al pi sheen balah immah; uvilvad sheyyehe makkiran. vehabbaal noten sachar.
b: Kotvin shetar lallove – af al pi sheen malve immo, veen kotvin lammalve – ad sheyyehe love immo. vehallove noten sachar.
Kotvin shetar lammocher – af al pi sheen lokeach immo, veen kotvin lallokeach – ad sheyyehe mocher immo. vehallokeach noten sachar.
En kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehem, vehechatan noten sachar.
En kotvin shetar arisut vekabbelanut ella middaat shenehem, vehamekabbel noten sachar.
En kotvin shetare berurin vechol maase bet din – ella middaat shenehem, ushenehem notnin sachar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lishnehem kotvin shenayim – laze leatzmo velaze leatzmo.
Gemara may "uvilvad sheyyehe makkiran"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: uvilvad sheyyehe makkir shem haish bagget, veshem haishsha bashshovar.

Yatev rav safra verav acha bar huna verav huna bar chinnana, veyatev abbaye gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekamibbaya lehu: shem haish bagget – in, shem haishsha – la?! shem haishsha bashshovar – in, shem haish – la?!
Velechush dilma katev gitta, veazel umamte leh leitteteh dehaych!
Vezimnin azla katva ishsha shovar, veyahava legavra delav dila!
Amar lehu abbaye, hachi amar rav: shem haish bagget – vehu haddin leshem haishsha. shem haishsha bashshovar – vehu haddin leshem haish.

Velechush lishne yosef ben shimon haddarim beir achat – dilma katev gitta, veazel umamte leh leitteteh dehaych! amar lehu rav acha bar huna, hachi amar rav: shene yosef ben shimon haddarim beir achat – en megarshin neshotehen ella ze bifne ze.
Velechush dilma azel lemata achrita umachzek leh lishmeh beyosef ben shimon, vechatev gitta umamte leh leitteteh dehaych!
Amar lehu rav huna bar chinnana, hachi amar rav: kol shehuchezak shemo bair sheloshim yom – en choshshin lo.
La ittachzak, may? amar abbaye: dekaru leh veane. rav zevid amar: rammaa – berammauteh zehir.
Hahu tevara dahava chatim ala rav yirmeya bar abba. atya lekammeh hahi itteta, amara leh: lav ana havay. amar, ana name amari lehu: lav ihi hi, vaamaru li: mikkash hu dekashsha la – uvegar la kala.
Amar abbaye, af al gav daamur rabbanan:

a: Kevan shehiggid, shuv eno chozer umaggid; tzureba merabbanan lav orcheh lemedak.
Hahu tevara dahava chatim aleh rav yirmeya bar abba. amara leh: lav ana havay. amar la: ivra ant havit. amar abbaye: af al gav detzureba merabbanan lav orcheh lemedak, kevan dedak – dak.
Amar abbaye: hay tzureba merabbanan deazel lekaddoshe itteta – nidbar am haaretz bahadeh, dilma mechallefu la minneh.
Vehabbaal noten sachar vechulei. may tama? deamar kera: "vechatav" "venatan". vehaiddana dela avdinan hachi, shadyuhu rabbanan aishsha ki hechi dela leshahayeh.
Kotvin shetar lallove – af al pi sheen malve immo vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, beiska.
Kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, bemocher sadehu mippene raatah.
En kotvin shetare erusin vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, daafillu tzureba merabbanan denicha leh lachamu lekaroveh.
En kotvin shetar arisut vekabbelanut vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, bevura.
En kotvin shetare verurin ella middaat shenehem vechulei. may "shetare verurin"? hacha targimu: shetare taanata. rav yirmeya bar abba amar: ze borer lo echad, veze borer lo echad.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lishnehem kotvin shenayim – leze beatzmo uleze beatzmo. lema bechofin al middat sedom ka mippalgi –
Demar savar: kofin, umar savar: en kofin?
La, dechulle alma kofin; vehacha hayeynu tama derabban shimon ben gamliel – daamar leh: la nicha li detehve zechutach gabbe zechuti, dedamet alay ki arya arva.

Mishna mi sheppara miktzat chovo, vehishlish et shetaro – veamar lo: "im lo natatti lecha mikkan vead yom peloni, ten lo shetaro", higgia zeman velo natan – rabbi yose omer: yitten, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yitten.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yose savar: asmachta kanya, verabbi yehuda savar: asmachta la kanya.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose. ki ato lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: vechi meachar sherabbi yochanan melammedenu paam rishona usheniyya halacha kerabbi yose, ani ma eese?
Veen halacha kerabbi yose.
Mishna mi shennimchak shetar chovo – maamid alav edim, uva lifne bet din, veosin lo kiyyum: "ish peloni ben peloni nimchak shetaro beyom peloni,
b: Ufeloni ufeloni edav".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: ezehu kiyyumo? "bemotav telata havena anu peloni ufeloni ufeloni, hotzi peloni ben peloni shetar machuk lefanenu beyom peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav". veim katuv bo: "huzekaknu leedutan shel edim, venimtzet edutan mechuvvevnet" – gove, veeno tzarich lehavi reaya. veim lav, tzarich lehavi reaya.
Nikra – pasul, nitkara – kasher. nimchak o nittashtesh – im rishshumo nikkar, kasher.
Hechi dame nikra, hechi dame nitkara? amar rav yehuda: nikra – kera shel bet din, nitkara – kera sheeno shel bet din.
Hechi dame kera shel bet din? amar rav yehuda: mekom edim umekom hazzeman umekom hattoref. abbaye amar: sheti vaerev.

Hanhu arvae daato lefumebdita, dahavo ka ansi arata deinashe. ato maravotayhu lekammeh deabbaye, amaru leh: lichze mar shetarin, velichtov lan mar shetara acharina aleh, dei mittenis chad – nekitinan chad bidan.
Amar lehu: may eeved lechu? deamar rav safra: en kotvin shene shetarot al sade achat, dilma taref vahadar taref.
Havo ka tardi leh, amar leh lesafreh: zil ketov lehu hu al hammechak veedav al hanneyayr, defasul.
Amar leh rav acha bar minyome leabbaye: vedilma rishshumo nikkar, vetanya: nimchak o nittashtesh – im rishshumo nikkar, kasher! amar leh: mi kaamena shetara mealleya? "alef bet" bealma kaamena.

Tanu rabbanan: hare shebba veamar "avad shetar chovi", af al pi sheamru edim "anu katavnu vechatamnu venatannu lo" – en kotvin lo et hashshetar. bamme devarim amurim – beshitre halevaa, aval shitre mikkach umimkar – kotvin, chutz min haachrayut shebbo.

a: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af shitre mikkach umimkar en kotvin. vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hannoten mattana lachavero, vehechzir lo et hashshetar – chazra mattenato. vachachamim omrim: mattenato kayyemet.
Amar mar: chutz meachrayut shebbo. may tama?

Amar rav safra: lefi sheen kotvin shene shetarot al sade achat; dilma azel baal chov taref leh lehay, veazel hay umappek chad – vetaref lakochot, veamar leh levaal chov: "shuf li deekum ba, vahadar ta tirfan". umappek acharina, vahadar azel taref lakochot acharine.
Vechevan dikraneh lishtara demalve, bemay hadar taref la?

Vechi tema dela keraneh, veha amar rav nachman: kol tirfa dela ketiv beh: "keraneh lishtara demalve" – lav tirfa hu. vechol adrachta dela ketiv ba: "keraneh letirfa" – lav adrachta hiv. vechol shuma dela ketiv bay: "keraneh leadrachta" – lav shuma hi.
La tzericha, dekaate mikkoach avahateh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: ulema leh lememar leh levaal chov: "shuf li behay ara veekum ba"? tippok leh dechevan denaket tere shetare – taref vahadar taref!
Im ken, nefishi aleh baale dinin.
Velichtov lehay shetara mealleya, velichtov tevara lemocher: "kol shetare deyippekun al ara da – pesulin, levar min deyippok bezimna da"!
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa, veamri la kammeh derav ashe: zot omeret, en kotvin shovar.
b: Amar lehu: bealma kotvin shovar, vehacha hayeynu tama – dedilma azel baal chov vetaref minneh delokeach, veazel ihu vetaref lakochot, veshovar gabbe lakochot lekka.
Sof sof, lakochot lav ammare deara hadri?
Addehachi vehachi shamet veachel pere.
I name, lelokeach shello beachrayut.
I hachi, shetare halevaa name!
Hatam, dezuze massek – amri: payyeyseh baal chov bezuze. hacha, deara massek – midda yadi deman demassek ara, bezuze la mippayyays.

Amar mar: chutz min haachrayut shebbo. hechi katvinan? amar rav nachman, dechatvi hachi: "shetara denan dela lemigbe beh la mimmeshabedi vela mibbene chare, ella ki hechi detekum ara bideh delokeach".
Amar rafram, zot omeret: achrayut – taut sofer hu; tama dichtav leh hachi, ha la ketav leh hachi – gave.
Rav ashe amar: achrayut – lav taut sofer hu, umay "chutz meachrayut shebbo" – dela ketiv beh achrayut.
Hahi itteta dihava leh zuze lehahu gavra lemizban la ara, azal zevan la shello beachrayut. atya lekammeh derav nachman,
Amar leh: "letakkone shaddartaycha, vela leauote. zil zivna minneh shello beachrayut, vahadar zabbena nihala beachrayut".

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hannoten mattana lachavero, vehechzir lo et hashshetar – chazra mattenato. vachachamim omrim: mattenato kayyemet. may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel? amar rav assi, naasa keomer lo: sade zo netuna lecha kol zeman shehashshetar beyadcha.
Matkef la rabba: i hachi, nignav o avad name!
Ella amar rabba: beotiyyot niknot bimsira kamippalgi – rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: otiyyot niknot bimsira, verabbanan savri: en otiyyot niknot bimsira.
Tanu rabbanan: habba liddon bishtar uvachazaka, niddon bishtar; divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bachazaka.
Bemay kamippalgi? ki ata rav dimi, amar: beotiyyot niknot bimsira ka mippalgi –

a: Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: en otiyyot niknot bimsira, verabbi savar: otiyyot niknot bimsira.
Amar leh abbaye: im ken, pelugeta lidmar! amar leh: vetiflog!
Amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: matnita la mittartza ella kedimtartza mar, veim ken kashya derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel!
Ella amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennimtza echad mehen karov o pasul;
Uviflugeta derabbi meir verabbi elazar ka mippalgi – rabbi savar la kerabbi elazar, deamar: ede mesira karti,
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar la kerabbi meir, deamar: ede chatima karti.
Veha amar rabbi abba: mode haya rabbi elazar bimzuyyayf mittocho, shehu pasul!

Ella amar rabbi avina, hakkol modim sheim katuv bo: "huzekaknu leedutan shel edim, venimtzet edutan mezuyyefet" – shehu pasul, kidrabbi abba; lo nechleku ella bishtar sheen alav edim kelal, derabbi savar la kerabbi elazar, deamar: ede mesira karti. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar la kerabbi meir, deamar: ede chatima karti.
Veibbaet ema: bemode bashshetar shekketavo tzarich lekayyeymo ka mippalgi,
Derabbi savar: mode bishtar shekketavo – en tzarich lekayyeymo. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: tzarich lekayyeymo.

Veha ippecha shaminan lehu! detanya: shenayim adukin bishtar, malve omer "shelli hu venafal mimmenni umetzato", velove omer "shellecha hu uferativ lach" – yitkayyem hashshetar bechotmav. divre rabbi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yachloku.

Vehavenan ba – velet leh lerabbi ha ditnan: shenayim ochazin betallit, ze omer "ani metzatiha" veze omer "ani metzatiha" – ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, veyachloku?

Veamar rava amar rav nachman: bimkuyyaym – dechulle alma la peligi deyachaloku. ki peligi – besheeno mekuyyaym, rabbi savar: mode bishtar shekketavo tzarich lekayyeymo, vei mekayyem leh – gave palga, vei la – chaspa bealma hu;
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: mode bishtar shekketavo – en tzarich lekayyeymo, veyachloku.
Efoch.
Veibbaet ema: leolam la tefoch, ella hacha bilvarer kamippalgi –

Ki ha derav yitzchak bar yosef hava massek beh zuze berabbi abba. ata lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha, amar: peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni. amar leh rabbi yitzchak: yavou peloni ufeloni veyaidu. amar leh: i la atu – la mehemnina?! veha kayyma lan: hammalve et chavero beedim – eno tzarich leforo beedim!

Amar leh: ana behahi – kishmata demar sevira li, deamar rabbi abba amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: haomer lachavero "peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni" – tzarich sheyyavou peloni ufeloni veyaidu. [amar leh,] veha amar rav giddel amar rav: halacha kedivre rabban shimon ben gamliel, veaf rabbi lo
b: Amar ella levarer! amar leh: ana name – levarer kaamena.

Mishna mi sheppara miktzat chovo, rabbi yehuda omer: yachlif, rabbi yose omer: yichtov shovar. amar rabbi yehuda: nimtza ze tzarich lihyot shomer shovaro min haachbarim! amar lo rabbi yose: kach yafe lo, velo yera kocho shel ze.
Gemara amar rav huna amar rav: en halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose; ella bet din mekarin hashshetar, vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon.

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna, veamri la rav yirmeya bar abba lerav huna: i shemia leh lerav ha [barayyta] detanya: edim mekarin et hashshetar, vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon – hava hadar beh.
Amar leh: shemia leh, vela hadar beh.

a: Bishlama be dina – allime leafkoe mamona. ella edim sheasu shelichutan – chozrin veosin shelichutan?!
Vela?! veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: edim kotvin afillu asara shetarot al sade achat!
Rav yosef amar: bishtar mattana,
Verabba amar: bishtar sheen bo achrayut.

May barayyta? detanya: hare shehayu noshin bo elef zuz, ufara mehen chamesh meot zuz – edim mekarin et hashshetar, vechotvin lo shetar acher mizzeman rishon, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: shetar ze yehe munnach bimkomo, veyichtevu shovar.
Umippene shene devarim amru kotvin shovar – achat, kede sheyyachof leforo; veachat, kede sheyyigbe mizzeman rishon.
Veha rabbi yehuda name mizzeman rishon kaamar! hachi kaamar leh rabbi yose lerabbi yehuda: i mizzeman rishon kaamrat – peligna alach bachada; i mizzeman sheni kaamrat – peligna alach betarte.

Tanu rabbanan: shetar shezzemanno katuv beshabbat o baasara betishri – shetar meuchar hu, vechasher; divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose posel. amar lo rabbi yehuda: vahalo maase ba lefanecha betzippori, vehichsharta! amar lo: keshehichsharti – baze hichsharti.
Veha rabbi yehuda name baze kaamar!
Amar rabbi pedat: hakkol modim sheim huzekaknu leonato shel shetar, venimtzet onato mechuvvevnet beshabbat o baasara betishri – sheshshetar meuchar hu, vechasher;
b: Lo nechleku ella bishtar meuchar bealma –
Derabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: en kotvin shovar, vela nafek minneh chureba;
Verabbi yose letameh, deamar: kotvin shovar, venafek minneh chureba.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: afillu leman deamar kotvin shovar, hane mille appalga, aval akkulleh – la.
Vela hi, afillu akkulleh katvinan.

Ki ha derav yitzchak bar yosef hava massek beh zuzi berabbi abba. ata lekammeh derabbi chanina bar pappe, amar leh: "hav li zuzayy". amar leh: "hav li shetaray, ushekol zuzach". amar leh: "shetarach irchas li, echtov lach tevara". amar leh: "ha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: en kotvin shovar!"
Amar: "man yahev lan meafreh derav ushemuel, raminan beayynin; ha rabbi yochanan veha resh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: kotvin shovar".
Vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi ila: kotvin shovar.
Umistabbera dechotvin shovar; dei salka data en kotvin shovar, avad shetaro shel ze – yochal halla vechade?!
Matkef la abbaye: veella may, kotvin shovar?! avad shovaro shel ze – yochal halla vechade? amar leh rava: in, "eved love leish malve".
Tenan hatam: shitre chov hammukedamin – pesulin, vehameucharin – kesherin.

Amar rav hamenuna: lo shanu ella shetare halevaa, aval shetare mikkach umimkar – afillu meucharin name pesulin. may tama? zimnin dimzabben leh ara benisan vechatev leh betishri, umitreme leh zuze bene bene vezaven lay minneh, vechi mate tishri – mappek leh, veamar leh: hadar zeventa minnach!

I hachi, shetare halevaa name – zimnin deyazef benisan uchetiv leh shetara betishri; umitreme leh zuze bene bene ufara leh, veamar leh: hav li shetaray, veamar leh: irchas li, vechatev leh tevara; vechi mate zimneh, mappek leh vaamar leh: hane hasheta hu dizaft minnay!
Kasavar: en kotvin shovar.

Amar leh rav yemar lerav kahana, veamri la rav yirmeya middifti lerav kahana: vehaiddana dechatvinan shetare meuchare vechatvinan tevara, ammay kaavdinan hachi? amar leh, batar daamar lehu rabbi abba lesafreh: ki katvitu shetare[10] meuchare, ketuvu hachi: "shetara denan la bezimneh ketavneh, ella acharnohi uchetavnohi".

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: vehaiddana – dela ka avdinan hachi? batar daamar leh rav safra lesafreh: ki katvitu hane tevare; i yaditu zimna dishtara – ketuvu, i la – ketuvu setama, dechol emat denafek – lareh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, veamri la rav ashe lerav kahana:

a: Veha haiddana – dela kaavdinan hachi! amar leh: rabbanan takkone takkinu; man deaved – aved, man dela aved – ihu hu deafsed annafsheh.
Amar lehu rava bar rav shela lehanhu katve shetare akneyata: ki katvitu shetare akneyata; i yaditu yoma diknetu beh – ketuvu, vei la – ketuvu yoma dekayymitu beh, ki hechi dela mitchaze keshikra.

Amar lehu rav lesafreh, vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafreh: ki kayymitu beshile – ketuvu beshile, veaf al gav dimsiran lechu mille behine; ki kayymitu behine – ketuvu behine, veaf al gav dimsiran lechu mille beshile.
Amar rava: hay man dinkit shetara bar mea zuze, veamar: shavveyu nihali tere bene chamshin chamshin, la meshavvenan lehu.
May tama? avadu rabbanan milleta denicha leh lemalve, venicha leh lelove; nicha leh lemalve – kede sheyyachof leforo, venicha lelove – ki hechi denifgom shetareh.
Veamar rava: hay man dinkit tere shetare bene chamshin chamshin, veamar: shavvinhu nihali chad bar mea – la meshavvenan leh.
Avud rabbanan milleta denicha leh lemalve, venicha leh lelove; nicha leh lemalve – ki hechi dela nifgom shetareh, venicha leh lelove – kede shello yachof leforo.
Amar rav ashe: hay man dinkit shetara bar mea zuze, veamar: shauonhi nihali chad bar chamshin – la meshavvena leh.
May tama? amrinan: hay mifra pareh, vaamar leh: hav li shetaray, vaamar leh: irchas li, uchetayv leh tevara; umappek leh hay, veamar leh: hay acharina hu.

Mishna shene achin – echad ani veechad ashir, vehinniach lahen avihen merchatz uvet habbad; asaan lesachar – hassachar laemtza. asaan leatzmo – hare heashir omer leani: "kach lecha avadim veyirchatzu bammerchatz, kach lecha zetim uvo vaase bevet habbad".
Shenayim shehayu beir achat, shem echad "yosef ben shimon" veshem acher "yosef ben shimon" – en yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze, velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov.
Nimtza leechad ben shetarotav "shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua" – shetarot shenehen peruin.
Ketzad yaasu? yeshalleshu, veim hayu meshullashin – yichtevu siman, veim hayu mesummanin – yichtevu kohen.
Gemara hahu shetara dinfak leve dina derav huna, dahava ketiv beh: "ani peloni bar peloni laviti mane mimmecha".
b: Amar rav huna: "mimmecha" – afillu meresh galuta, vaafillu mishshabbur malka.
Amar leh rav chisda lerabba: pok ayyen bah, dilureta bae la rav huna minnach.
Nefak dak veashkach – detanya: get sheyyesh alav edim veen bo zeman, abba shaul omer: im katuv bo "gerashtiha hayyom" – kasher.
Alma "hayyom" – hahu yoma denafek beh mashma; hacha name, mimmecha – mehahu gavra denafek mittute yedeh mashma.
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma abba shaul kerabbi eliezer sevira leh, deamar: ede mesira karti; aval hacha lechush linfila!
Amar leh: linfila la chayyshinan. umena temra dela chayyshinan linfila?

Ditnan: shenayim shehayu beir achat, shem echad yosef ben shimon veshem acher yosef ben shimon – enan yecholin lehotzi shetar chov ze al ze, velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov. ha hem al acherim – yecholin; veammay? lechush linfila! ella lav shema minna linfila la chayyshinan?
Veabbaye – linfila dechad la chayyshinan, linfila derabbim chayyshinan.

a: Veella ha detanya: keshem sheen motziin shetar chov ze al ze – kach en motziin al acherim, bemay kamippalgi?
Beotiyyot niknot bimsira kamippalgi –
Tanna didan savar: otiyyot niknot bimsira; vetanna bara savar: en otiyyot niknot bimsira.
Vei baet ema: dechulle alma – otiyyot niknot bimsira, vehacha betzarich lehavi reaya ka mippalgi – tanna didan savar: en tzarich lehavi reaya, vetanna bara savar: tzarich lehavi reaya –
Deittemar: otiyyot niknot bimsira; abbaye amar: tzarich lehavi reaya, verava amar: eno tzarich lehavi reaya.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: echad min haachin shehashshetar chov yotze mittachat yado, alav lehavi reaya. may, lav hu haddin leachrine?
Verava amar: shane achin, deshamtu mehadade.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: echad min haachin shehashshetar chov yotze mittachat yado – alav lehavi reaya. achin hu deshamtu mehadade, aval achrine la.
Veabbaye – achin itztericha leh, salka datach amena: kevan deshamtu mehadade – ema miz(d)har zehiri, vela tzerichi lehavi reaya; kamashma lan.
Veella ha detanya: keshem shemmotziin hen shetar chov al acherim – kach motziin ze al ze; bemay kamippalgi?
Bechotvin shetar lallove veaf al pi sheen malve immo kamippalgi –

Tanna didan savar: kotvin shetar lallove, veaf al pi sheen malve immo; zimnin deazel legabbe safra vesahade, veamar lehu: ketuvu li shetara, devaenan lemezaf miyyosef ben shimon chavray; uvatar dechatvi vechatmi leh, naketo leh veamar leh: hav li mea dizaft minnay.
Tanna bara savar: en kotvin shetar lallove, ad sheyyehe malve immo.

Nimtza leechad ben shetarotav "shetaro shel yosef ben shimon parua" – shetarot shenehem peruin vechulei. tama denimtza, ha lo nimtza – matze mappek; vehaanan "velo acher yachol lehotzi alehen shetar chov" tenan!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: bimshullashin.
Venecheze tevara – bishma deman dichtiv! amar rav hoshaya: bimshullashin bashshetar, veen meshullashin bashshovar.
Abbaye amar, hachi kaamar: nimtza lallove ben shetarotav "shetaro shel yosef ben shimon alay, parua" – shetarot shenehem peruin.
Ketzad yaasu? yeshalleshu kulei. tana: im hayu shenehem kohanim, yichtevu dorot.
Mishna haomer livno: "shetar ben shetarotay parua, veeni yodea e zehu" – shetarot kullan peruin. nimtza leechad sham shenayim – haggadol parua, vehakkatan eno parua.
Gemara amar rava: "shetar lecha beyadi, parua" – haggadol parua vehakkatan eno parua. "chov lecha beyadi, parua" – shetarot kullan peruin.
Amar leh ravina lerava: ella meatta, "sadi mechura lach" – sade gedola mechura lo; "sade sheyyesh li, mechura lach" – kol sedotav mechurin lo?!
Hatam, yad baal hashshetar al hattachtona.
Mishna hammalve et chavero al yede arev, lo yippara min hearev.
b: Veim amar lo: "al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze" – yippara min hearev. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im yesh nechasim lallove – ben kach uven kach lo yippara min hearev.
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hearev leishsha bichtubbatah, vehaya balah megarshah – yaddirenna hanaa; shemma yaasu kenuneya al nechasim shel ze, veyachzir et ishto.
Gemara may tama? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: gavra ashlemt li, gavra ashlemi lach.
Matkef la rav nachman: hay – dina defarsae!
Adderabba, batar arva azli!
Ella be dina defarsae – dela yahavi tama lemilletayyhu.
Ella amar rav nachman: may "lo yippara min hearev" – lo yitba arev techilla.
Tanya name hachi: hammalve et chavero al yede arev – lo yitba arev techilla. veim amar: "al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze" – yitba arev techilla.
Amar rav huna: minnayin learev demishtabed? dichtiv: "anochi eervennu, miyyadi tevakshennu".
Matkef la rav chisda: ha kabbelanut hi – dichtiv: "tena oto al yadi, vaani ashivennu"!
Ella amar rabbi yitzchak, mehacha: "lekach bigdo ki arav zar, uvead nochriyya chavlehu".

Veomer: "beni, im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha, nokashta veimre ficha nilkadta beimre ficha, ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha, lech hitrappes urehav reecha" – im mamon yesh lo beyadecha, hatter lo pissat yad; veim lav, harebe alav reim.
Amar ammemar: arev demishtabad, machloket rabbi yehuda verabbi yose; lerabbi yose deamar: asmachta kanya – arev mishtabad. lerabbi yehuda deamar: asmachta la kanya – arev la mishtabad.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar: ha maasim bechol yom, deasmachta la kanya vearev mishtabad!
Ella amar rav ashe: behahu hanaa deka meheman leh – gamar umishtabad nafsheh.
Veim amar "al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze" kulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella sheen nechasim lallove, aval yesh nechasim lallove – lo yippara min hearev.
Veha middekatane sefa, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im yesh nechasim lallove – lo yippara min hearev, mikkelal detanna kamma savar: la shena hachi vela shena hachi!

Chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hammalve et chavero al yede arev – lo yippara min hearev. veim amar "al menat sheeppara mimmi sheertze" – yippara min hearev. bamme devarim amurim – besheen nechasim lallove; aval yesh nechasim lallove – lo yippara min hearev. vekabbelan, af al pi sheyyesh nechasim lallove – yippara min hakkabbelan.

a: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im yesh nechasim lallove – echad ze veechad ze lo yippara mehen.
Amar rabba bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu – halacha kemoto; chutz mearev, vetzaydan, ureaya acharona.
Amar rav huna: "halevehu vaani arev"; "halevehu vaani porea"; "halevehu vaani chayyayv"; "halevehu vaani noten" – kullan leshon arvut hen.
"Ten lo vaani kabbelan"; "ten lo vaani porea"; "ten lo vaani chayyayv"; "ten lo vaani noten" – kullan leshon kabbelanut hen.
Ibbaya lehu: "halevehu vaani kabbelan"; "ten lo vaani arev" – may?
Amar rabbi yitzchak: leshon arvut – arvut, leshon kabbelanut – kabbelanut.
Rav chisda amar: kullan leshon kabbelanut hen, bar mehalevehu vaani arev".
Rava amar: kullan leshon arvut hen, bar mitten lo vaani noten".
Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe, hachi amar abba: "ten lo vaani noten" – en lammalve al hallove kelum.
Vela hi; la mippetar love minneh demalve, ad sheyyissa veyitten bayyad.
Hahu dayyayna deachateh lemalve lenichse [delove] mikkamme delitbeeh lelove, sallekeh rav chanin bereh derav yeva.

Amar rava: man chakkim lemebad ki ha milleta, i lav rav chanin bereh derav yeva! kasavar: nichseh devar inish – innun mearvin yateh; utenan: hammalve et chavero al yede arev – lo yippara min hearev, vekayyma lan: lo yitba arev techilla.
Hahu arva deyatme, defareh lemalve mikkamme delodinhu leyatme;
Amar rav pappa: periat baal chov mitzva, veyatme lav bene mebad mitzva ninhu.
Verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: emar tzerare atpeseh.
b: May benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu keshechayyayv mode. i name, deshammetuhu umit beshamteh.
Shelachu mittam: shammetuhu umit beshamteh, hilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
Metivi: arev shehaya shetar chov yotze mittachat yado – eno gove. veim katuv bo: "hitkabbalti mimmecha" – gove.
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua – mashkachat la keshechayyayv mode, ella lerav pappa – kashya!
Shane hatam, lehachi terach uchetav leh "hitkabbalti".

Hahu arva degoy defareh legoy mikkamme delitbeinhu leyatme. amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derava: afillu leman deamar chayyshinan litzrare – hane mille yisrael; aval goy, kevan devatar arva azel – la chayyshinan litzrare.
Amar leh: adderabba! afillu leman deamar la chayyshinan litzrare – hane mille yisrael; aval goyim, kevan dedinayyhu batar arva azli, i lav deatpeseh tzerare meikkara – la hava mekabbel leh.

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hearev leishsha bichtubbatah [vechulei]. moshe bar atzri arva dichtubbeta dechallateh hava. rav huna bereh – tzureba midderabbanan hava, udechika leh milleta. amar abbaye: lekka denezil denasseveh etza lerav huna, dingarsha lidvethu vetezil vetigbe ketubba meavu, vahadar nahdera?
Amar leh rava: veha "yaddirenna hanaa" tenan! amar leh abbaye: attu kol dimgaresh – beve dina megaresh?
Lesof iggallay milleta dechohen hu. amar abbaye, hayeynu deamri inashe: batar anya azla anyuta.
Umi amar abbaye hachi? veha amar abbaye: ezehu "rasha arum"? ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel!
Beno shane, vetzureba merabbanan shane.
Veha arev hu, [vekayyma lan] arev dichtubba lo mishtabed! kabbelan hava.
Hanicha leman deamar: kabbelan dichtubba – af al gav delet leh nichse levaal, mishtabad – shappir. ella leman deamar: i it leh mishtabad, i let leh la mishtabad – may ikka lememar?
Ibbaet ema: mihve hava leh, veishteduf. veibbaet ema: abba legabbe bereh – shabode meshabad nafsheh.

Deittemar: arev dichtubba – divre hakkol la mishtabad. kabbelan devaal chov – divre hakkol mishtabad. kabbelan dichtubba, vearev devaal chov – peligi; mar savar: i it leh nichse lelove – mishtabad, i let leh – la mishtabad; umar savar: ben it leh uven let leh – mishtabad.
Vehilcheta: arev – ben it leh uven let leh, mishtabad; bar mearev dichtubba – deaf al gav deit leh levaal, la mishtabad. may tama? mitzva hu daavad, velav midde chassere.
Amar rav huna: shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav, veamar "mane lifloni beyadi" – neeman; chazaka en adam ose kenuneya al hekdesh.

Matkef la rav nachman: vechi adam ose kenuneya al banav?! derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: shechiv mera sheamar "mane lifloni beyadi"; amar "tenu" – notnin. lo amar "tenu" – en notnin. alma adam asuy shello lehasebia et banav;

a: Hacha name, adam asuy shello lehasebia et atzmo!
Ki kaamar rav huna hatam – denaket shetara.
Mikkelal derav ushemuel – dela naket shetara; amar "tenu" – notnin?! milve al pe hava, verav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: milve al pe – eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot!
Ella amar rav nachman: idde veidde denaket shetara, vela kashya – ha dimkuyyaym, ha dela mekuyyaym; amar "tenu" – kayyeymeh lishtareh, lo amar "tenu" – la kayyeymeh lishtareh.
Amar rabba: shechiv mera sheamar "mane lifloni beyadi", veamru yetomin "paranu" – neemanin. "tenu mane lifloni", veamru yetomin "paranu" – en neemanin.
Kelappe leyay? ippecha mistabbera! amar "tenu mane" – kevan defaska avuhon lemilleta, ikka lememar defareh. "mane lifloni beyadi" – kevan dela pesak avuhon lemilleta, ikka lememar dela pareh!

Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: shechiv mera sheamar "mane lifloni beyadi", veamru yetomin: "chazar veamar lanu abba: parati" – neemanin. may tama? iddechore middechar. "tenu mane lifloni", veamru yetomin: "chazar veamar abba: parati" – en neemanin. deim ita defareh, la hava amar "tenu".

Bae rava: shechiv mera shehoda, mahu? tzarich lomar "attem eday", o en tzarich lomar "attem eday"? tzarich sheyyomar "ketovu" o en tzarich lomar "ketovu"? adam meshatte bishat mita, o en adam meshatte bishat mita?
Batar devaya, hadar pashta – en adam meshatte bishat mita, vedivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu.
Mishna hammalve et chavero bishtar – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. al yede edim – govin minnechasim bene chorin.
b: Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyayv lo – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Arev hayyotze leachar chittum shetarot – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Maase uva lifne rabbi yishmael, veamar: gove minnechasim bene chorin. amar lo ben nannas: eno gove lo minnechasim meshuebadim velo minnechasim bene chorin.

Amar lo: lamma? amar lo: hare hachonek et echad bashshuk, umetzao chavero veamar lo "hannach lo [vaani etten lach]" – patur, shello al emunato hilvahu. ella eze hu arev shehu chayyayv? "halevehu, vaani noten lach" – chayyayv, shekken al emunato hilvahu.

Veamar rabbi yishmael: harotze sheyyachkim – yaasok bedine mamonot; sheen lach miktzoa battora yoter mehen, vehen kemayayn hannovea. veharotze sheyyaasok bedine mamonot – yeshammesh et shimon ben nannas.

Gemara amar ulla: devar tora – echad milve bishtar, veechad milve al pe – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. may tama? shibuda deorayyta. veella ma taam amru milve al pe eno gove ella minnechasin bene chorin? mishshum peseda delakochot.
I hachi, milve bishtar name! hatam, inhu ninhu deafsidu annafshayyhu.

Verabba amar: devar tora – echad milve bishtar veechad milve al pe – eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin. may tama? shibuda lav deorayyta. uma taam amru milve bishtar gove minnechasim meshuebadim? kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
I hachi, milve al pe name! hatam let leh kala.
Umi amar rabba hachi? veha amar rabba: gavu karka – yesh lo. gavu maot – en lo!
Vechi tema efoch derabba leulla udeulla lerabba, veha amar ulla: devar tora, baal chov dineh bezibburit!
Ella rabba – tama divne mareva kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: milve al pe – eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot. may tama? shibuda lav deorayyta.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayyhu: milve al pe – gove ben min hayyorshin, uven min hallakochot. may tama? shibuda deorayyta.
Metivi: hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal alav shor vaharago – patur. velo od, ella sheim met hashshor – yorshe baal habbor chayyayvim leshallem deme shor livalav!
Amar rabbi ila amar rav: besheamad baddin.
Veha "harago" katane! amar rav adda bar ahava: sheasao terefa.
Veha amar rav nachman, tane tanna: "met ukevaro"! hatam – deyatvi dayyayne appumma devera, vechayyeyvuhu.

a: Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: milve al pe – gove min hayyorshin, veeno gove min hallakochot. gove min hayyorshin – kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin, veeno gove min hallakochot – delet leh kala.

Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyayv lo – gove minnechasim bene chorin vechulei. bea minneh rabbah bar natan merabbi yochanan: huchezak ketav yado bevet din, may? amar leh: af al pi shehuchezak ketav yado bevet din – eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin.

Metiv rame bar chama: shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset – havvalad kasher. veellu hen: katav bichtav yado – veen alav edim; yesh alav edim – veen bo zeman; yesh bo zeman – veen bo ella ed echad; hare ellu shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset – havvalad kasher.
Rabbi elazar omer: af al pi sheen alav edim, ella shennetano lah bifne edim – kasher, vegove minnechasim meshuebadim.
Shane hatam, demishsheat ketiva hu deshabad nafsheh.
Arev hayyotze leachar chittum shetarot vechulei. amar rav: kodem chittum shetarot – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. leachar chittum shetarot – gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Zimnin amar rav: afillu kodem chittum shetarot – eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin.
Kashya derav adderav! la kashya; ha dichtiv beh "peloni arev". ha dichtiv beh "ufeloni arev".
Verabbi yochanan amar: echad ze veechad ze – eno gove ella minnechasim bene chorin, veaf al gav dichtiv beh "ufeloni arev".
Metiv rava: edim hachatumin al sheelat shalom beget – pasul; chayyshinan shemma al sheelat shalom chatmu.
Veamar rabbi avahu, ledidi mipparsha leh minneh derabbi yochanan: "sheilu" – pasul. "usheilu" – kasher!
Hacha name, dichtiv "peloni arev".
I hachi, hayeynu derav! ema: vechen amar rabbi yochanan.
Maase uva lifne rabbi yishmael vechulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi shekkilles rabbi yishmael et ben nannas, halacha kemoto.
Ibbaya lehu: bechanuk – ma li amar rabbi yishmael? ta shema, deamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: chaluk haya rabbi yishmael af bechanuk.
Halacha kemoto, o en halacha kemoto? ta shema, dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: chaluk haya rabbi yishmael af bechanuk, vahalacha kemoto af bechanuk.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chanuk, vekanu miyyado – mishtabed. mikkelal dearev bealma – la bae kinyan. ufeliga derav nachman, deamar rav nachman:
b: Arev devet din hu dela bae kinyan, ha bealma bae kinyan.
Vehilcheta: arev bishat mattan maot – lo bae kinyan, achar mattan maot – bae kinyan. arev devet din – la bae kinyan; divhahi hanaa dimheman leh – gamar umeshabed leh.
Hadaran alach get pashut, uselika la massechet bava batra

a: Mishna dine mamonot – bishlosha, gezelot vachavalot – bishlosha, nezek vachatzi nezek, tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha – bishlosha.
Haones vehamefatte vehammotzi shem ra – bishlosha, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: motzi shem ra – beesrim ushelosha, mippene sheyyesh bo dine nefashot.
Makkot bishlosha. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: beesrim ushelosha.

Ibbur hachodesh – bishlosha. ibbur hashshana – bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bishlosha matchilin, uvachamishsha nosin venotnin, vegomrin beshiva. veim gamru bishlosha – meubberet.
Semichat zekenim vaarifat egla – bishlosha, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: bachamishsha. hachalitza vehammeunin – bishlosha.
Neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin – bishlosha. hahekdeshot – bishlosha. haarachin hammittaltelim – bishlosha. rabbi yehuda omer: echad mehen kohen.
Vehakkarkaot – tisha vechohen. veadam – kayyotze bahen.
Dine nefashot – beesrim ushelosha. harovea vehannirba – beesrim ushelosha, shenneemar: "veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema", veomer: "veet habbehema taharogu".

Shor hanniskal – beesrim ushelosha, shenneemar: "hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat". kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor. hazzeev vehaari, haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash – mitatan beesrim ushelosha. rabbi eliezer omer: kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha. rabbi akiva omer: mitatan beesrim ushelosha.

En danin lo et hashshevet, velo et nevi hashsheker, velo et kohen gadol, ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. veen motziin lemilchemet harshut ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. en osin sanhedrayot lashshevatim ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad.
En osin ir hanniddachat, ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. en osin ir hanniddachat bassefar, velo shalosh, aval osin achat o shetayim.

Sanhedrin gedola hayta shel shivim veechad, uketanna shel esrim ushelosha. minnayin laggedola shehi shel shivim veechad? shenneemar: "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael", umoshe al gabbehen. rabbi yehuda omer: shivim.
Uminnayin lakketanna shehi shel esrim ushelosha? shenneemar: "veshaftu haeda", "vehitztzilu haeda". eda shofetet veeda matztzelet – hare kan esrim.
Uminnayin leeda shehi asara? shenneemar: "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot", yatzu yehoshua vechalev.

Uminnayin lehavi od shelosha? mimmashma shenneemar "lo tihye achare rabbim leraot" shomea ani sheehye immahem letova. im ken, lamma neemar "achare rabbim lehattot"? lo kehattayaytcha letova hattayaytcha leraa. hattayaytcha letova – al pi echad, hattayaytcha leraa – al pi shenayim.
b: Veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehem od echad. hare kan esrim ushelosha.
Vechamma yehe bair utehe reuya lesanhedrin? mea veesrim. rabbi nechemya omer: matayim usheloshim, keneged sare asarot.
Gemara attu gezelot vechabbalot lav dine mamonot ninhu? amar rabbi avahu: ma hen katane, ma hen dine mamonot? gezelot vechabbalot. aval hodaot vehalevaot – la.

Utzericha, dei tena dine mamonot – hava amena daafillu hodaot vehalevaot. tena gezelot vachavalot. vei tena gezelot vachavalot, vela katane dine mamonot – hava amena hu haddin daafillu hodaot vehalevaot. vehay dekatane gezelot vachavalot – mishshum deikkar shelosha dichtivi, bigzelot vachavalot ketivi.
Gezelot, dichtiv: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim". chavalot – ma li chaval begufo, ma li chaval bemamono! tena: ma hen dine mamonot? gezelot vachavalot. aval hodaot vehalevaot – lo.
Ulemay? illema dela baenan shelosha, vehaamar rabbi avahu: shenayim sheddanu dine mamonot, ledivre hakkol en dinehem din.
Ella: dela baenan mumechin.
May kasavar? i kasavar eruv parashiyyot katuv kan, live name mumechin. vei kasavar en eruv parashiyyot katuv kan, shelosha lema li?

Leolam kasavar: eruv parashiyyot katuv kan, uvedin hu delive name mumechin. vehay dela baenan mumechin – mishshum derabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: devar tora, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira,

a: Shenneemar: "mishpat echad yihye lachem". uma taam amru dine mamonot la baenan derisha vachakira? kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
Ella meatta, tau – lo yeshallemu?! kol shekken atta noel delet bifne lovin!
I hachi, tarte katane: dine mamonot bishlosha hedyotot, gezelot vachavalot bishlosha mumechin.
Veod, shelosha shelosha lema li?
Ella amar rava: tarte katane, mishshum derabbi chanina. rav acha bereh derav ika amar: middeorayyta chad name kasher, shenneemar "betzedek tishpot amitecha". ella mishshum yoshve keranot.
Attu bitlata mi la havu yoshve keranot? i efshar delet behu chad digmir. ella meatta, tau – lo yeshallemu?! kol shekken dinfishi yoshve keranot!

May ikka ben rava lerav acha bereh derav ika? ikka benayyhu – deamar shemuel: shenayim sheddanu, dinehen din, ella shennikreu bet din chatzuf. lerava let leh dishmuel, lerav acha bereh derav ika it leh dishmuel.
Nezek vachatzi nezek vechulei. nezek hayeynu chavalot? mishshum deka bae lemitne chatzi nezek, tane name nezek shalem.
Chatzi nezek name – hayeynu chavalot! tena mamona, vekatane kenasa.
Hanicha leman deamar: "palga nizka kenasa", ella leman deamar: "palga nizka mamona", may ikka lememar?
Ella, ayyeyde deka bae lemitne tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, demamon
b: Sheeno mishtallem berosh hu, tena name chatzi nezek, demamon sheeno mishtallem berosh hu. veayyeyde deka bae lemitne chatzi nezek, tena name nezek.

Shelosha menalan? detanu rabbanan: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim" – hare kan echad, "ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem" – hare kan shenayim, "asher yarshiun elohim" – hare kan shelosha, divre rabbi yoshiyya.

Rabbi yonatan omer: rishon techilla neemar, veen dorshin techillot. ella "ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem" – hare kan echad, "asher yarshiun elohim" – hare kan shenayim, veen bet din shakul. mosifin alehen od echad – hare kan shelosha.

Nema bedorshin techillot kamippalgi? demar savar: dorshin techillot, umar savar: en dorshin techillot. la, dechulle alma en dorshin techillot. amar lach rabbi yoshiyya: im ken, nema kera "venikrav baal habbayit el hashshofet". may "el haelohim"? shema minna leminyayna.
Verabbi yonatan, lishshana dealma nekat, kidamri inashe: man deit leh dina – likrav legabbe dayyayna.
Verabbi yoshiyya let leh bet din note? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer, ma talmud lomar "lintot achare rabbim lehattot"? hattora amra: ase lecha bet din note.
Savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: shivim. ditnan: sanhedri gedola hayta shel shivim veechad, rabbi yehuda omer: shivim.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda besanhedri gedola, dichtivi kerae. bishar be dina mi shamat leh?
Vechi tema: la shena, vehatnan: semichat zekenim vaarifat egla bishlosha, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: bachamishsha.
Veamrinan: may tama derabbi yehuda? "vesamchu" – shenayim, "zikne" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad, hare kan chamishsha.

Derabbi yoshiyya adifa midderabbi yehuda, deillu rabbi yehuda besanhedri gedola hu delet leh, ha bishar be dina it leh. verabbi yoshiyya bishar be dina name let leh. veella hay "lintot" may aved leh? mokem le bedine nefashot.
Aval bedine mamonot – la? ella ha ditnan: shenayim omrim zakkay veechad omer chayyayv – zakkay, shenayim omrim chayyayv veechad omer zakkay – chayyayv. nema dela kerabbi yoshiyya?
Afillu tema rabbi yoshiyya, mayyte la bekal vachomer middine nefashot: uma dine nefashot dachamiri, amar rachamana "zil batar rubba", dine mamonot lo kol shekken?

Tanu rabbanan: dine mamonot bishlosha, rabbi omer: bachamishsha, kede sheyyiggamer haddin bishlosha. attu bitlata mi la gamar dina bitre? hachi kaamar: mippene sheggemar din bishlosha. alma kasavar: telata ki ketivi – bigmar dina ketivi.

Megaddef ba rabbi avahu: ella meatta, tehe sanhedri gedola tzericha mea vearbaim veechad, kede sheyyiggamer haddin beshivim veechad? utehe sanhedri ketanna tzericha arbaim vachamishsha, kede sheyyiggamer haddin bishlosha veesrim?

Ella "esfa li shivim ish" amar rachamana, mishsheat asifa shivim. "veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda" name, mishsheat shefitat haeda. hachi name: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim", mishsheat keriva shelosha.

Ella, hayeynu tama derabbi: "asher yarshiun elohim" – tere. neemar "elohim" lematta veneemar "elohim" lemala. ma lematta shenayim, af lemala shenayim. veen bet din shakul – mosifin alehem od echad. hare kan chamishsha.

a: Verabbanan: "yarshiun" ketiv.
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yose amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi, verabbi yehuda ben roetz, uvet shammay, verabbi shimon, verabbi akiva – kullehu sevira lehu yesh em lammikra.
Rabbi, ha daamaran.
Verabbi yehuda ben roetz, detanya: shaalu talmidim et rabbi yehuda ben roetz: ekra ani "shivim", yachol tehe yoledet nekeva temea shivim?
Amar lahen: timme vetiher bazzachar, vetimme vetiher bannekeva. ma keshettiher bazzachar – bannekeva kiflayim, af keshettimme bazzachar – bannekeva kiflayim.
Leachar sheyyatzu, yatza umachazir acharehem. amar lahen: i attem zekukim lechach. "shevuayim" karenan, veyesh em lammikra.

Bet shammay, ditnan: bet shammay omrim, kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat – kipper, shenneemar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech". uvechattat – shete mattanot. uvet hillel omrim: af bechattat shennetanan bemattana achat – kipper.
Veamar rav huna: may tama devet shammay? "karnot", "karnot", "karnot" – hare kan shesh: arba lemitzva, ushetayim leakkev.
Uvet hillel omrim: karnot, karnat, karnat – hare kan arba. shalosh lemitzva, veachat leakkev.
Veema: kullehu lemitzva? kappara bichdi la ashkechan!

Rabbi shimon, detanya: shetayim kehilchatan, ushelishit afillu tefach. rabbi shimon omer: shalosh kehilchatan, ureviit afillu tefach. bemay kamippalgi? rabbanan savri: yesh em lammasoret, verabbi shimon savar: yesh em lammikra.
Rabbanan savri: yesh em lammasoret. "bassukkat", "bassukkat", "bassukkot" – hare kan arba. dal chad kera legufeh, pashu lehu telat. atay hilcheta, gerata lishlishit, veokemta attefach.
Verabbi shimon savar: "bassukkot", "bassukkot", "bassukkot" – hare kan shesh. dal chad kera legufeh, pashu lehu arba. atay hilcheta gerata lirviit, veokmeh attefach.

Rabbi akiva, detanya: rabbi akiva omer, minnayin lirviit dam sheyyatza mishshene metim shemmetamme beohel? shenneemar: "al kol nafshot met lo yavo" – shete nefashot veshiur echad. verabbanan: "nafshot" ketiv.
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: mi ikka delet leh "yesh em lammikra"? vehatanya: "bachalev immo" – yachol "bechelev"?
b: Amarta: yesh em lammikra.
Ella, dechulle alma yesh em lammikra, verabbi verabbanan beha kamippalgi: rabbi savar "yarshiun elohim" – acharine, verabbanan savri "yarshiun" – dehaych vehay.
Verabbi yehuda ben roetz, la peligi rabbanan aleh.
Bet hillel, detanya: "vechipper", "vechipper", "vechipper" – mippene haddin.
Vahalo din hu: neemar damim lematta, veneemar damim lemala. ma damim haamurim lematta – shennetanan bemattana achat kipper, af damim haamurim lemala – shennetanan bemattana achat kipper.

O kelach lederech zo: neemar damim bachutz, veneemar damim bifnim. ma damim haamurim bifnim – chisser achat mimmattanot lo asa velo kelum, af damim haamurim bachutz – chisser achat mimmattanot lo asa kelum.
Nire lemi dome? danin chutz michutz, veen danin chutz mippenim.
O kelach lederech zo: danin chattat vearba keranot, mechattat vearba keranot, veal yochiach ze, sheen chattat vearba keranot.

Talmud lomar: "vechipper", "vechipper", "vechipper" – mippene haddin. "kipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shelosha, "kipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shetayim, "kipper" – af al pi shello natan ella achat.
Verabbi shimon verabbanan beha peligi: rabbi shimon savar, sechacha la bae kera. verabbanan savri, sechacha bae kera.
Verabbi akiva verabbanan, beha peligi: rabbi akiva savar "nefashot" – tarte mashma, verabbanan savri "nefashot" – dealma mashma.
Udechulle alma yesh em lammikra? vehatanya: "letotefet", "letotefet", "letotafot" – hare kan arba, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, tat bechatpi shetayim, pat beafriki shetayim.
Ella, leolam peligi. vehane mille ki peligi – hecha deshane kera mimmasoret. aval hay "chelev" vachalev" dechi hadade ninhu, yesh em lammikra.

Vahare "yire" "yerae" dechi hadade ninhu, ufeligi? detanya: yochanan ben dahavay omer mishshum rabbi yehuda ben tema: hassome beachat meenav – patur min hariyya, shenneemar "yire" "yerae" – kederech shebba lirot kach ba leraot. ma lirot bishte enav, af leraot bishte enav.
Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika: amar kera "lo tevashshel gedi", derech bishshul asra tora.
Tanu rabbanan: dine mamonot bishlosha,

a: Veim haya mumeche lerabbim, dan afillu yechidi. amar rav nachman: kegon ana dan dine mamonot bichidi. vechen amar rabbi chiyyay: kegon ana dan dine mamonot bichidi.
Ibbaya lehu: kegon ana digmirna usevirna unekitna reshuta, aval la nekit reshuta – dineh la dina? o dilma: af al gav dela naket reshuta – dineh dina?

Ta shema: demar zutera bereh derav nachman dan dina utea, ata lekammeh derav yosef. amar lo: im kibbeluch alayyhu – la teshallem, vei la – zil shallem. shema minna: ki la naket reshuta – dineh dina. shema minna.
Amar rav: hay man devae lemedan dina, vei tea mive lemippetar – lishkol reshuta mibbe resh galuta. vechen amar shemuel: lishkol reshuta mibbe resh galuta.
Peshita: mehacha lehacha, umehatam lehatam – mahane. umehacha lehatam name mahane, dehacha shevet vehatam mechokek.
Kidtanya: "lo yasur shevet mihuda" – ellu rashe galiyyot shebbevavel, sherodin et yisrael beshevet. "umechokek mibben raglav" – ellu bene banav shel hillel, shemmelammedin tora barabbim.

Mehatam lehacha may? ta shema: derabba bar chana dan dina utea. ata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay. amar leh: i kibbeluch alayyhu – la teshallem, vei la – zil shallem. veha rabba bar chana reshuta hava nekit! shema minna: mehatam lehacha la mahane. shema minna.

Vela mahane? veha rabba bar rav huna, ki hava minnetze bahade deve resh galuta, amar: lav minnayychu nekitna reshuta, nekitna reshuta meabba mari, veabba mari merav, verav merabbi chiyyay, verabbi chiyyay merabbi! bemilleta dealma hu deokem lehu.
Vechi meachar dela mahane, rabba bar chana reshuta dinkat lema li? laayayrot haomdim al haggevulin.
May reshuta? ki hava nachet rabba bar chana levavel, amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi: ben achi yored levavel. "yore?" "yore!", "yadin?" "yadin!", "yattir bechorot?" "yattir!".
Ki hava nachet rav levavel, amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi: ben achoti yored levavel. "yore?" "yore!", "yadin?" "yadin!", "yattir bechorot?" "al yattir!".

May shena lemar deka kare "ben achi", umay shena lemar deka kare "ben achoti"? vechi tema hachi hava maase, vehaamar mar: ayyevu vechanna veshela umarta verabbi chiyyay kullehu bene abba bar acha karsalla mikkafri havo? rav bar achu dahava bar achateh, rabba bar chana bar achu delav bar achateh.
Vei baet ema:
b: Al shem chochmato, dichtiv: "emor lachochma achoti at".
Yattir bechorot? al yattir. may tama? illema mishshum dela chakkim, ha ka amrinan dechakkim tuva! ella mishshum dela bekia bemume.
Vehaamar rav: shemona asar chodashim gadalti etzel roe vehema, leda eze mum kavua veeze mum over? ella, lechallek lo kavod lerabba bar chana.
Veibbaet ema: mishshum ha gufeh, derav bekia bemume tefe, veshare mume dela yadi inashe. veamri: "ki hay gavvna shera rav", veatu lemishre mum over.
Yore, yore. i gemir, reshuta lema li lemishkal? mishshum maase shehaya.

Detanya: paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad, veraa bene adam shemmegabbelin issotehem betumea. amar lahem: mippene ma attem megabbelin issotechem betumea? amru lo: talmid echad ba lechan vehora lanu: me vetzaim en machshirin. vehu me vetzim derash lehu, veinhu sevur me vetzaim kaamar.

Vetau name beha: me keramyon ume fega pesulin, mippene shehen me vetzaim. veinhu sevur: middilgabbe chattat pesili – achshore name la machsheri. vela hi: hatam, leinyan chattat, baenan mayim chayyim; hacha, achshore kol dehu machsheri.
Tana, beotah shaa gazru: talmid al yore ella im ken notel reshut merabbo.

Tanchum bereh derabbi amme ikkela lecheter. derash lehu: muttar liltot chittin bappesach. amru lo: lav rabbi manni demin tzur ikka hacha? vetanya: talmid al yore halacha bimkom rabbo, ella im ken haya rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot keneged machane yisrael. amar lehu: lav addatay.
Rabbi chiyyay chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava kae bevet hakkevarot. amar leh: lav ben ish peloni kohen atta? amar leh: in. avu dehahu gavra geva enayim hava, natan enav bigrusha vechillelo.
Peshita, lefalga – ha kaamar demahane. al tenay may? ta shema, daamar leh rabbi yochanan lerav shemen: hare atta birshutenu ad shettavo etzlenu.

Gufa, amar shemuel: shenayim sheddanu – dinehem din, ella shennikra bet din chatzuf. yatev rav nachman vekaamar leha shemata. etiveh rava lerav nachman: afillu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayyeyvin veechad omer eni yodea – yosifu haddayyaynin. vei ita, lihvo kishnayim sheddanu!
Shane hatam, demeikkara addata ditlata yetivi. hacha, lav addata ditlata yetevi.

Etiveh, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: haddin bishlosha, ufeshara bishnayim. veyafe koach peshara mikkoach haddin, sheshshenayim sheddanu – baale dinin yecholin lachazor bahen, ushenayim sheasu peshara – en baale dinin yecholin lachazor bahen.

a: Vechi tema: peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel, vehaamar rabbi avahu: shenayim sheddanu – ledivre hakkol en dinehem din! gavra aggavra ka ramet?

Gufa, amar rabbi avahu: shenayim sheddanu dine mamonot – ledivre hakkol en dinehem din. etiveh rabbi abba lerabbi avahu: dan et haddin vezikka et hachayyayv, vechiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hattahor, tiher et hattame – ma sheasa asuy, umeshallem mibbeto.
Hacha bemay askinan? dekaybluhu alayyhu. i hachi, ammay meshallem mibbeto? deamru leh: dayynat lan din tora.
Amar leh rav safra lerabbi abba: dita bemay? ilema dita bidvar mishna, vehaamar rav sheshet amar rabbi amme: taa bidvar mishna chozer? ella dita beshikkul haddaat.

Hechi dame beshikkul haddaat? amar rav pappa: kegon tere tannae utere amorae difligi ahadade, vela ittemar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar, vesugeyayn dealma allibba dechad minnayyhu, vaazal ihu vaavad keiddach – hayeynu shikkul haddaat.
Lema ketannae: bitztzua bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: peshara beyachid. savruha, lechulle alma makkeshinan peshara ledin.

May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: din bishlosha, umar savar: din bishnayim? la, dechulle alma din bishlosha, vehacha beha kamippalgi: demar savar makkeshinan peshara ledin, umar savar la makkeshinan peshara ledin.

Lema: telata tannae bifshara, demar savar bishlosha, umar savar bishnayim, umar savar beyachid. amar rav acha bereh derav ika, veittema rabbi yemar bar shelemya: man deamar tere – afillu chad name, vehay dekaamar tere – ki hechi delihvo aleh sahadi.
Amar rav ashe: shema minna peshara enah tzericha kinyan, dei salka datach tzericha kinyan, leman deamar tzericha – telata lema li? tisge bitre velikne minneh! vehilcheta: peshara tzericha kinyan.
Tanu rabbanan: keshem shehaddin bishlosha, kach bitztzua bishlosha.
b: Nigmar haddin, i atta rashshay livtzoa.

600 452 Siman. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: asur livtzoa, vechol habbotzea – hare ze chote, vechol hamevarech et habbotzea – hare ze menaetz. veal ze neemar: "botzea berech nietz Adonai".

Ella yikkov haddin et hahar, shenneemar: "ki hammishpat lelohim hu". vechen moshe haya omer: yikkov haddin et hahar. aval aharon ohev shalom verodef shalom, umesim shalom ben adam lachavero, shenneemar: "torat emet hayta befihu veavla lo nimtza visfatav beshalom uvemishor halach itti verabbim heshiv meavon".
Rabbi eliezer omer: hare sheggazal sea shel chittim, utechanah vaafaah vehifrish mimmenna challa, ketzad mevarech? en ze mevarech ella menaetz. veal ze neemar: "uvotzea berech nietz Adonai".

Rabbi meir omer: lo neemar "botzea" ella keneged yehuda, shenneemar: "vayyomer yehuda el echav ma betza ki naharog et achinu". vechol hamevarech et yehuda – hare ze menaetz, veal ze neemar: "uvotzea berech nietz Adonai".

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: mitzva livtzoa, shenneemar: "emet umishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem". vahalo bimkom sheyyesh mishpat – en shalom, uvimkom sheyyesh shalom – en mishpat? ella ezehu mishpat sheyyesh bo shalom? heve omer: ze bitztzua.
Vechen bedavid hu omer: "vayhi david ose mishpat utzedaka". vahalo kol makom sheyyesh mishpat – en tzedaka, utzedaka – en mishpat? ella ezehu mishpat sheyyesh bo tzedaka? heve omer: ze bitztzua.
Atan letanna kamma. dan et haddin, zikka et hazzakkay vechiyyev et hachayyayv. veraa shennitchayyev ani mamon, veshillem lo mittoch beto – ze mishpat utzedaka.

Mishpat laze utzedaka laze: mishpat laze – shehechzir lo mamon, utzedaka laze – sheshshillem lo mittoch beto. vechen bedavid hu omer: "vayhi david ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo". mishpat laze – shehechzir lo et mamono, utzedaka laze – sheshshillem lo mittoch beto.

Kashya leh lerabbi: hay "lechol ammo" – laaniyyim mibbee leh! ella, rabbi omer: af al pi shello shillem mittoch beto, zehu mishpat utzedaka. mishpat laze utzedaka laze: mishpat laze – shehechzir lo mamono, utzedaka laze – shehotzi gezela mittachat yado.

Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: shenayim shebbau lefanecha laddin, ad shello tishma divrehen, o mishshettishma divrehen vei atta yodea lehechan din note – atta rashshay lomar lahen: "tzeu uvitzu". mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note – i atta rashshay lomar lahen: "tzeu uvitzu", shenneemar: "poter mayim reshit madon velifne hitgalla hariv netosh". kodem shennitgalla hariv – atta yachol lenotsho; mishshennitgalla hariv – i atta yachol lenotsho.

Veresh lakish amar: shenayim shebbau laddin, echad rach veechad kashe, ad shello tishma divrehem, o mishshettishma divrehen veen atta yodea lehechan din note – atta rashshay lomar lahem: "en ani nizkak lachem", shemma nitchayyev chazak venimtza chazak rodfo. mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note – i atta yachol lomar lahen: "eni nizkak lachem", shenneemar: "lo taguru mippene ish".

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: minnayin letalmid sheyyoshev lifne rabbo veraa zechut leani vechova leashir, minnayin shello yishtok? shenneemar: "lo taguru mippene ish". rabbi chanin omer: lo tachnis devarecha mippene ish. vihu edim yodim et mi hen meidin, velifne mi hen meidin, umi atid lippara mehen, shenneemar: "veamdu shene haanashim asher lahem hariv lifne Adonai".

Vihu haddayyaynin yodin et mi hen danin, velifne mi hen danin, umi atid lippara mehen, shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el". vechen bihoshafat hu omer: "vayyomer el hashshoftim reu ma attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki im laAdonai". shemma yomar haddayyayn: ma li betzaar hazze? talmud lomar: "immachem bidvar mishpat". en lo laddayyayn ella ma sheenav root.

Hechi dame gemar din? amar rav yehuda amar rav: ish peloni atta chayyayv, ish peloni atta zakkay. amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha. ini? veha rav huna talmideh derav hava! ki hava atu lekammeh derav huna amar lehu: i dina baetu, i peshara baetu? may "mitzva" name dekaamar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha?

a: Mitzva lememra lehu: i dina baetu, i peshara baetu? hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu mitzva: rabbi yehoshua ben korcha savar mitzva, tanna kamma savar reshut.
Hayeynu derabbi shimon ben menasya? ikka benayyhu: mishshettishma divrehen veatta yodea lehechan haddin note, i atta rashshay lomar lahen "tzeu uvitzu".

Ufeliga derabbi tanchum bar chanilay, deamar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: lo neemar mikra ze ella keneged maase haegel, shenneemar: "vayyar aharon vayyiven mizbeach lefanav". ma raa? amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: raa chur shezzavuach lefanav.

Amar: i la shamana lehu hasheta, avdu li kedaavadu bechur, umikkayaym bi "im yehareg bemikdash Adonai kohen venavi", vela havya lehu takkanta leolam. mutav delibedu leegel, efshar havya lehu takkanta bitshuva.

Vehane tannae "poter mayim reshit madon", may darshi beh? kidrav hamenuna, deamar rav hamenuna: en techillat dino shel adam niddon ella al divre tora, shenneemar: "poter mayim reshit madon". amar rav huna: hay tigra damya letzinnora devidka (demayya), kevan deravavch – ravavch.
Abbaye kashshisha amar: dame legudda degamla, kevan dekam – kam.
Shimi ushete sheva zemirot hu, siman.
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: tuveh deshama veadesh, chalfu bishateh mea. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "poter mayim reshit madon" – resh mea dine.
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: attarte telat gannava la mikketal. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu".
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: shav bere lishlamana, vachada leaved bish. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "ki sheva yippol tzaddik vakam verasha yippol beachat".
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: deazel mibbe dina shekil gelima – lizammar zemar velezil beorcha. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "vegam kol haam hazze al mekomo yavo veshalom".
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: hi nayyma, vedikkula shafel. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare vegomer".
Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: gavra dirchitzna aleh, adyeh ligzizeh vekam. amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda, kera ketiv: "gam ish shelomi asher batachti vo vegomer".

Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: ki rechimtin hava azziza, apputeya desafsera shechivan. hasheta dela azziza rechimtin, pureya bar shittin garmide la saggi lan. amar rav huna, kerae ketivi. meikkara ketiv: "venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet", vetanya: aron tisha vechapporet tefach, hare kan asara.

Uchetiv: "vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo laAdonai shishshim amma orko veesrim rochbo usheloshim amma komato". ulevassof ketiv: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay eze vayit asher tivnu li vegomer".

May mashma dehay "lo taguru" lishshana dechannoshe hu? amar rav nachman, amar kera: "veyayin lo tishte velo teegor". rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha: "tachin bakkayitz lachmah agra vakkatzir maachalah". rav acha bereh derav ika amar mehacha: "oger bakkayitz ben maskil".

Emet mamon yira siman. amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol dayyayn sheddan din emet laamitto, mashre shechina beyisrael, shenneemar: "elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot". vechol dayyayn sheeno dan din emet laamitto, gorem lishchina shettistallek miyyisrael, shenneemar: "mishshod aniyyim meankat evyonim atta akum yomar Adonai vegomer".

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol dayyayn shennotel mizze venoten leze shello kaddin, hakkadosh baruch hu notel mimmennu nafsho, shenneemar: "al tigzol dal ki dal hu veal tedakke ani vashshaar ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava et kovehem nafesh".
Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: leolam yire dayyayn atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo ben yarchotav, vegehinnam petucha lo mittachtav.
b: Shenneemar: "hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael kullam achuze cherev melummede milchama ish charbo al yerecho mippachad ballelot". mippachdah shel gehinnam, sheddoma lelayla.

Darash rabbi yoshiyya, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak, may dichtiv: "bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek" – vechi babboker danin vechol hayyom en danin? ella im barur lecha haddavar kabboker – omrehu, veim lav – al tomrehu. rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yonatan, mehacha: "emor lachochma achoti at" – im barur lecha haddavar kaachotcha shehi asura lecha – omrehu, veim lav – al tomrehu.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asara sheyyoshvin baddin, kolar taluy betzavvar kullan. peshita! la tzericha ella letalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo.

Rav huna, ki hava ate dina lekammeh, meychannef umayyti asara rabbanan mibbe rav. amar: ki hechi delimteyayn shibba mikkeshura. rav ashe, ki hava ate terefta lekammeh, mechannef umayyte lehu lechullehu tabbache demata machseya. amar: ki hechi delimteyayn shibba mikkeshura.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: darash rav nachman bar kohen, may dichtiv: "melech bemishpat yaamid aretz veish terumot yehersenna"? im dayyayn dome lemelech sheeno tzarich lichlum – yaamid aretz, veim dome lechohen shemmechazzer bevet haggeranot – yehersenna.
Deve nesia okmu dayyayna dela hava gemir. amar leh lihuda bar nachmani, meturegmaneh deresh lakish: "kum aleh beamora". kam, gechen aleh, vela amar leh vela midde.

Patach veamar: "hoy omer laetz hakitza uri leeven dumam hu yore hinne hu tafus zahav vachesef vechol ruach en bekirbo". veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lippara mimmaamidan, shenneemar: "vaAdonai behechal kodsho has mippanav kol haaretz".

Amar resh lakish: kol hammaamid dayyayn al hatztzibbur sheeno hagun, keillu notea ashera beyisrael, shenneemar: "shoftim veshotrim titten lecha", usemich leh: "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz". amar rav ashe: uvimkom sheyyesh talmide chachamim, keillu netao etzel mizbeach, shenneemar: "etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha".
Ketiv: "lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav". elohe chesef velohe zahav hu dela avdi, ha deetz shere? amar rav ashe: eloah habba bishvil kesef, veeloah habba bishvil zahav.
Rav, ki hava ate leve dina, amar hachi: birut nafsheh liktala nafek, utzevu beteh let hu aved, verekan leveteh ayel. ulevay shettehe bia kitzia.

Ki have chaze ambuha desafre abbatreh, amar: "im yaale lashshamayim sio [vegomer] kegello lanetzach yoved vegomer". mar zutera chasida, ki havo mechattefi leh beshabbeta derigla, amar hachi: "ki lo leolam chosen veim nezer ledor vador".

Daresh bar kappara: mena ha milleta daamaru rabbanan, "hevu metunin baddin"? dichtiv: "lo taale vemaalot", usemich leh "veelle hammishpatim". amar rabbi eliezer: minnayin ledayyayn shello yefassea al rashe am kodesh? shenneemar: "lo taale vemaalot", usemich leh "veelle hammishpatim".

"Asher tasim"? "asher telammedem" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ellu kele haddayyaynin. rav huna, ki hava nafek ledina, amar hachi: appiku li mane chanutay: makkel uretzua, veshofara, vesandala.

"Vaatzavve et shoftechem baet hahi". amar rabbi yochanan: keneged makkel uretzua tehe zariz. "shamoa ben achechem ushefattem" – amar rabbi chanina: azhara laddayyayn shello yishma divre baal din kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero, veazhara levaal din shello yatim devarav laddayyayn kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. keri beh name: "shamma ben achechem".
Rav kahana amar: mehacha, millo tissa" – lo tassi.
"Ushefattem tzedek". amar resh lakish: tzaddek et haddin, veachar kach chotchehu. "ben ish uven achiv uven gero". amar rav yehuda: afillu ben bayit laaliyyay.
"Uven gero". amar rav yehuda: afillu ben tannur lechirayim.
"Lo takkiru fanim bammishpat". rabbi yehuda omer: lo takkirehu. rabbi elazar omer: lo tenakkerehu.
Ushepizchaneh derav ata lekammeh ledina. amar lo: lav ushepizchani at? amar lo: in. amar leh: dina it li. amar leh:

a: Pesilna lach ledina. amar leh rav lerav kahana: pok dayyeyneh. chazyeh dahava ka gaes beh. amar leh: i tzayytat – tzayytat, vei la – mappekna lach rav meunnach.
"Kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun". amar resh lakish: sheyyehe chaviv alecha din shel peruta kedin shel mea mane. lemay hilcheta? illema leayyone beh umifsekeh – peshita! ella leakdomeh.

"Lo taguru mippene ish". amar rabbi chanan: al tachnis devarecha mippene ish. "ki hammishpat lelohim hu". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, lo dayyayn larshaim shennotlin mizze mamon venotnim laze shello kaddin, ella shemmatrichin oti lehachazir mamon livalav.

"Vehaddavar asher yikshe mikkem". amar rabbi chanina veittema rabbi yoshiyya: al davar ze neenash moshe, shenneemar "vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai". matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: mi ketiv "veashmiachem"? "ushemativ" ketiv! i gemirna – gemirna, vei la – azelna ugemirna.

Ella, kidtanya: reuya parashat nachalot shettikkatev al yede moshe rabbenu, ella shezzachu benot tzelafchad venichteva al yadan. reuya hayta parashat mekoshesh shettikkatev al yede moshe rabbenu, ella shennitchayyev mekoshesh venichteva al yado. lelammedcha shemgalgelin chova al yede chayyayv, uzechut al yede zakkay.

Ketiv: "vaatzavve et shoftechem baet hahi", uchetiv: "vaatzavve etchem baet hahi". amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi simlay: azhara latztzibbur shettehe emat dayyayn alehen, veazhara laddayyayn sheyyisbol et hatztzibbur. ad kamma? amar rabbi chanan, veittema rabbi shabbetay: "kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek".

Ketiv: "ki atta tavo", uchetiv: "ki atta tavi". amar rabbi yochanan: amar lo moshe lihoshua: atta vehazzekenim shebbaddor immahem. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: tol makkel vehach al kodkodam. dabbar echad laddor, veen shene dabbarin laddor.

Tana: zimmun bishlosha. may zimmun? illema birkat zimmun, vehatanya: zimmun uvirkat zimmun bishlosha! vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh: may zimmun? birkat zimmun. vehatanya: zimmun bishlosha, birkat zimmun bishlosha!

Ella may zimmun? azmone ledin. ki ha deamar rava: hane be telata dayyayne deyatvi, veazel shelicha deve dina veamar mippumma dechad – lo amar kelum, ad deamar mishshemeh dechullehu. hane mille bela yoma dedina, aval beyoma dedina – let lan ba.

Tashlume kefel kulei. shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov: yelammedenu rabbenu, dine kenasot bechamma? may kamibbaya leh? ha anan tenan bishlosha! ella yachid mumeche kamibbaya leh, deen dine kenasot o la?

Amar leh: tenetuha, tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha bishlosha. may shelosha? illema shelosha hedyotot, haamar avu daavuch mishshemeh derav: afillu asara vehen hedyotot pesulin ledine kenasot! ella mumechin, vekaamar shelosha.
Vachachamim omrim: motzi shem ra beesrim ushelosha.
Vechi yesh bo dine nefashot, may have?
Amar ulla: bechoshshin lelaaz kamippalgi. rabbi meir savar: en choshshin lelaaz, verabbanan savri: choshshin lelaaz.

Rava amar: kulle alma lelaaz la chayyshinan, vehacha bechoshshin lichvodan shel rishonim kamippalgi. vehacha bemay askinan? kegon deikkenif be esrin utelata lemedan dine nefashot, veibbaddur, vaamar lehu: dayyeynu li miha dine mamonot.
b: Metivi: vachachamim omrim, tevao mamon – bishlosha, tevao nefashot – beesrim ushelosha. bishlama lerava, tevao mamon techilla – bishlosha, tevao nefashot techilla – afillu mamon beesrim ushelosha. ella leulla kashya!

Amar rava: ani vaari shebbachavura targemna. umannu? rav chiyyay bar avin. hacha bemay askinan? shehevi habbaal edim shezzinneta, vehevi haav edim vehezimmum leede habbaal. ba ligbot mamon mibbaal – bishlosha, uvimkom nefashot – beesrim ushelosha.
Abbaye amar: dechulle alma chayyshinan lelaaz, umishshum kevodan shel rishonim. hacha bemay askinan? kegon deatro ba setam.
Vehay tanna hu, detanya: ushear kol chayyayve mitot shebbattora, en memitin otam ella beeda veedim vehateraa, vead sheyyodiuhu shehu chayyayv mita bevet din.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyodiuhu beezo mita hu neherag.

Rav pappa amar: hacha beishsha chavera askinan, vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi yose bar yehuda verabbanan. detanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: chaver en tzarich hateraa, lefi shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.
Rav ashe amar: kegon

a: Deatro bay malkot, vela atro bay katla.
Vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi yishmael verabbanan, ditnan: makkot bishlosha. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: beesrim ushelosha.

Ravina amar: kegon shennimtza echad min haedim karov o pasul, vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi yose verabbi, allibba derabbi akiva. ditnan: rabbi akiva omer, lo ba shelishi ella lehachemir alav, laasot dino kayyotze baellu.
Im ken anash hakkatuv et hannitpal leovre avera keovre avera – al achat kamma vechamma sheyyeshallem sachar lannitpal leose mitzva keose mitzva.
Uma shenayim, nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – edutan betela, af shelosha, nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – edutan betela. uminnayin sheafillu mea? talmud lomar: "edim".

Amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim? bedine nefashot, aval bedine mamonot titkayyem edut bashshear. rabbi omer: echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot, veematay? bizman shehitru bahen, aval bizman shello hitru bahen,
b: Ma yaasu shene achim veechad, sherau beechad sheharag et hannefesh?

Veibbaet ema: kegon shehitru bah acherim, velo hitru bah edim. vekamippalgi biflugeta derabbi yose verabbanan, ditnan: rabbi yose omer, leolam eno neherag ad sheyyehu pi shene edav matrin bo, shenneemar: "al pi shenayim edim".
Veibbaet ema: kegon deittachchush bivdikot, vela ittachchush bachakirot.
Vekamippalgi biflugeta deven zakkay verabbanan, ditnan: maase uvadak ben zakkay beuketze teenim.
Amar rav yosef: hevi habbaal edim shezzinneta, vehevi haav edim vehezimmum leede habbaal, ede habbaal neheragin veen meshallemin mamon.
Chazar vehevi habbaal edim, vehezimmum leede haav. ede haav neheragin, umeshallemin mamon. mamon laze, unefashot laze.
Veamar rav yosef: "peloni revao leonso" – hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo.
"Lirtzono" – rasha hu, vehattora amra: "al tashet rasha ed". rava amar: adam karov etzel atzmo, veen adam mesim atzmo rasha.
Amar rava:

a: "Peloni ba al ishti", hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo, aval lo lehorgah.
May ka mashma lan? dimfalleginan bedibbura? hayeynu hach! mahu detema: adam karov etzel atzmo – amrinan, etzel ishto – la amrinan. ka mashma lan.
Veamar rava: "peloni ba al naara hameorasa", vehuzzammu – neheragin, veen meshallemin mamon. "bitto shel peloni", vehuzzammu – neheragin umeshallemin mamon. mamon laze unefashot laze.
Veamar rava: "peloni rava hashshor" vehuzzammu – neheragin, veen meshallemin mamon. "shoro shel peloni" vehuzzammu – neheragin, umeshallemin mamon. mamon laze, unefashot laze.

Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! mishshum deka vae baya illaveh, devae rava: "peloni rava shori", mahu? mi amrinan: adam karov etzel atzmo, veen adam karov etzel mamono? o dilma amrinan: adam karov etzel mamono? batar devaya hadar pashta: adam karov etzel atzmo, veen adam karov etzel mamono.
Makkot bishlosha kulei. menahane mille? amar rav huna: amar kera "ushefatum" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehem od echad. hare kan shelosha.
Ella meatta, "vehitzdiku" – shenayim, "vehirshiu" – shenayim, hare kan shiva? hahu mibbee leh kidulla, deamar ulla: remez leedim zommin min hattora minnayin?
Remez leedim zommin?! veha ketiv: "kaasher zamam"! ella, remez leedim zommin shellokin minnayin? dichtiv: "vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha".

Mishshum dehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha", "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha"? ella, edim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik, vaato ede acharine vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik demeikkara, veshavvinhu lehanach reshaim, "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha".
Vetippok leh millo taane"! mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav.

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: beesrim ushelosha. may tama derabbi yishmael? amar abbaye: atya "rasha" "rasha" mechayyayve mitot. ketiv hacha: "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha", uchetiv hatam: "asher hu rasha lamut". ma lehallan beesrim ushelosha, af kan beesrim ushelosha.
Rava amar: malkot bimkom mita omedet. amar rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: i hachi, umedana lema li? limchayeh, vei maet – lemut!

Amar leh: amar kera: "venikla achicha leenecha" – ki machet, aggabba dechaye machet. ella ha detanya: amaduhu lekabbel esrim – en makkin oto ella makkot haruyot lehishtallesh. vechamma hen? tamne sere,
b: Limchayeh esrim vachada, vechi mayet behach chada – lemut, deha ki mache aggabba dechayyay ka mache. amar leh: amar kera "venikla achicha leenecha" – achar shellaka, "achicha" baena, velekka.
Ibbur hachodesh bishlosha. chishshuv la katane, kiddush la katane, ella ibbur. la likaddesheh, umimmela liabbar?

Amar abbaye: teni kiddush hachodesh. tanya name hachi: kiddush hachodesh veibbur hashshana bishlosha, divre rabbi meir. amar rava: veha "ibbur" katane! ella amar rava: kiddush beyom ibbur bishlosha, achar ibbur lekka kiddush.
Umanni? rabbi elazar ben tzadok hi. detanya, rabbi elazar ben tzadok omer: im lo nira bizmanno – en mekaddeshin oto, shekkevar kiddeshuhu bashshamayim.
Rav nachman amar: kiddush achar ibbur – bishlosha, beyom ibbur – lekka kiddush. umanni? pelemo hi, detanya, pelemo omer: bizmanno – en mekaddeshin oto, shello bizmanno – mekaddeshin oto.
Rav ashe amar: leolam chishshuv katane, umay ibbur? chishshuv deibbur. veayyede dekavae lemitne ibbur shana, tena name ibbur chodesh.

Chishshuv chodesh – in, kiddush chodesh – la. manni? rabbi eliezer hi, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer, ben bizmanno ben shello bizmanno en mekaddeshin oto, shenneemar: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana". shanim atta mekaddesh, vei atta mekaddesh chodashim.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bishlosha kulei. tanya: ketzad amar rabban shimon ben gamliel? bishlosha matchilin, uvachamishsha nosin venotnin, vegomrin beshiva. echad omer leshev, ushenayim omrim shello leshev – batel yachid bemiuto.

Shenayim omrim leshev, veechad omer shello leshev – mosifin alehem od shenayim, venosin venotnin baddavar. shenayim omrim tzericha, ushelosha omrim enah tzericha – batlu shenayim bemiutan. shelosha omrim tzericha, ushenayim omrim enah tzericha – mosifin alehem od shenayim, sheen hamminyan pachot mishshiva.

Hane shelosha chamishsha veshiva, keneged mi? peligi ba rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani vechad deimmeh, umannu? rabbi shimon ben pazzi. veamri la: rabbi shimon ben pazzi vechad deimmeh, umannu? rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani. chad amar: keneged birkat kohanim, vechad amar: shelosha – keneged shomre hassaf, chamishsha – meroe pene hammelech, shiva – roe pene hammelech.

Tane rav yosef: hane shelosha vachamishsha veshiva, shelosha – keneged shomre hassaf, chamishsha – meroe pene hammelech, shiva – roe pene hammelech. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ad haiddana may tama la paresh lan mar hachi? amar lehu: la hava yadana ditzrichitu. mi beetu minnay milleta vela amari lechu?
Zeman, nasi, tzarich, gedi – siman. tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana ella

a: Bimzummanin lah. maase berabban gamliel sheamar: hashekimu li shiva laaliyyay. hishkim umatza shemona. amar: mi hu sheala shello birshut? yered!

Amad shemuel hakkatan veamar: ani hu shealiti shello birshut, velo leabber hashshana aliti ella lilmod halacha lemaase hutzerachti. amar lo: shev beni, shev. reuyot kol hashshanim kullan lehitabber al yadecha, ella amru chachamim: en meabberin et hashshana ella bamzummanin lah. vela shemuel hakkatan hava, ella inish acharina, umechamat kissufa hu daavad.

Ki ha deyatev rabbi veka daresh, veheriach reach shum. amar: mi sheachal shum yetze. amad rabbi chiyyay veyatza. amdu kullan veyatzu. bashshachar metzao rabbi shimon berabbi lerabbi chiyyay. amar leh: atta hu shetztziarta leabba? amar lo: lo tehe kezot beyisrael!

Verabbi chiyyay mehecha gemir la? merabbi meir, detanya: maase beishsha achat shebbata levet midrasho shel rabbi meir. amra lo: rabbi, echad mikkem kiddeshani bevia. amad rabbi meir vechatav lah get keritut venatan lah. amdu katvu kullam venatnu lah.

Verabbi meir mehecha gemir la? mishshemuel hakkatan. ushemuel hakkatan mehecha gemir la? mishshechanya ven yechiel, dichtiv: "vayyaan shechanya ven yechiel mibbene elam vayyomer leezra anachnu maalnu velohenu vannoshev nashim nochriyyot meamme haaretz veatta yesh mikve leyisrael al zot".

Ushechanya ven yechiel mehecha gemar la? mihoshua, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al panecha chata yisrael". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi chata? amar lo: vechi delator ani? lech hattel goralot. veibbaet ema: mimmoshe, dichtiv: "ad ana meantem".
