Tanu rabbanan: mishshemmetu neviim haacharonim chaggay zecharya umalachi, nistalleka ruach hakkodesh miyyisrael. veaf al pi chen hayu mishtammeshin bevat kol. paam achat hayu mesubbin baaliyyayt bet gureya biricho, venittena alehem bat kol min hashshamayim: yesh kan echad sherauy shettishre alav shechina kemoshe rabbenu, ella sheen doro zakkay lechach. natnu chachamim et enehem behillel hazzaken. ucheshemmet, amru alav: hi chasid, hi anav, talmido shel ezra.

Shuv paam achat hayu mesubbin baaliyya beyavne, venittena alehem bat kol min hashshamayim: yesh kan echad sherauy shettishre alav shechina, ella sheen doro zakkay lechach. natnu chachamim et enehem bishmuel hakkatan. ucheshemmet, amru alav: hi chasid, hi anav, talmido shel hillel. af hu amar bishat mitato: shimon veyishmael lecharba, vechavrohi liktala, ushear amma levizza, veakan saggian atidan lemete al alma.
Veal yehuda ben bava bikkeshu lomar ken, ella shennitrefa shaa, sheen maspidin al haruge malchut.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken yirtze nasi. umaase berabban gamliel shehalach littol reshut etzel hegmon echad shebbesureya, veshaha lavo, veibberu et hashshana al menat sheyyirtze rabban gamliel. ucheshebba rabban gamliel veamar "rotze ani", nimtzet shana meubberet.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken hayta tzericha, mippene hadderachim, umippene haggesharim, umippene tannure fesachim, umippene galiyyot yisrael shenneekru mimmekoman vaadayin lo higgiu. aval lo mippene hashsheleg, velo mippene hatztzinna, velo mippene galiyyot yisrael shello akru mimmekoman.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana lo mippene haggedayim, velo mippene hattelaim, velo mippene haggozalot shello perchu, aval osin otan saad lashshana. ketzad? rabbi yannay omer mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: mehodin anachna lechon degozalayyay rakkichin, veimmerayya dadekin, vezimna daaviva la meta, ushefarat milleta beanpay, veosefit al shatta da telatin yomin.
Metivi: kamma ibbur hashshana? sheloshim yom. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chodesh. amar rav pappa: ratzu – chodesh, ratzu – sheloshim yom.

b: Takkifey kadmae, leinvevtane batrae.
Detanya: maase berabban gamliel shehaya yoshev al gav maala behar habbayit, vehaya yochanan sofer hallaz omed lefanav, veshalosh iggerot chatuchot lefanav munnachot.

Amar lo: tol iggarta chada uchetov: laachana bene galila illaa velaachana bene galila tattaa, shelomchon yisge. mehodin anachna lechon dizman biura meta leafroshe masera mimmatana dezeta. vetol iggarta chada uchetov: laachana bene daroma, shelomchon yisge. mehodin anachna lechon dizman biura meta leafroshe masera meumere shuvelayya.

Vetol iggarta chada uchetov: laachana bene galvavta bevavel, velaachana divmaday, velishar kol galvota deyisrael, shelomchon yisge lealam. mehodin anachna lechon degozalayya rakkichin, veimmerayya dadekin, vezimna daaviva la meta, ushefara milleta beanpay uveanpe chaverayy, veosefit al shatta da yomin telatin. dilma batar deabberuho.
Tanu rabbanan: al shelosha devarim meabberin et hashshana – al haaviv, veal perot hailan, veal hattekufa. al shenayim mehen meabberin, veal echad mehen en meabberin.
Uvizman sheaviv echad mehen – hakkol semechin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: al hattekufa. ibbaya lehu: al hattekufa semechin, o al hattekufa meabberin? teku.

Tanu rabbanan: al shelosha aratzot meabberin et hashshana – yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. al shetayim mehen meabberin, veal achat mehen en meabberin. uvizman sheyyehuda achat mehen – hakkol semechin, sheen omer ba ella mihuda.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshanim ella bihuda, veim ibberuha baggalil – meubberet. heid chananya ish ono: im ibberuha baggalil – enah meubberet. amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: may tama dachananya ish ono? amar kera: "leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma", kol derishot sheatta doresh lo yihyu ella beshichno shel makom.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana ella beyom, veim ibberuha ballayla – enah meubberet. veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bayyom, veim kiddeshuhu ballayla – eno mekuddash. amar rav abba: may kera: "tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu". ezehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo? heve omer: ze rosh hashshana. uchetiv: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov". ma mishpat bayyom – af kiddush hachodesh beyom.
